name: Text Field
description: Labeled native text input for user-entered values. Label, supporting/error messaging, semantic invalid state, and native input attributes form the public boundary; Figma state/content axes remain derived representation.

props.name: label
props.description: Required visible field label associated to the native input.

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Optional supporting guidance associated to the input with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Semantic validation state. When true the native input exposes aria-invalid and the shell/message use negative feedback roles.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Optional error content shown and described when invalid; falls back to supportingText when absent.

props.name: required
props.description: Forwarded native required attribute; a visual required indicator mirrors it.

representations.mapsTo: private input-control CSS from native input:hover
private input-control CSS from native input:focus-visible

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label row associated to the native input.

anatomy.name: input-control
anatomy.description: Private dse._input-control shell using its default 44px size.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native input element that owns value, focus, disabled, required, and change behavior.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional supporting or error message associated via aria-describedby.

states.name: hover
states.description: Visual hover is derived from the native input and private shell.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Focus presentation is derived from native input focus-visible.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Public semantic invalid state mapped to aria-invalid and negative visual feedback.

states.name: invalid-focus
states.description: Combination of public invalid state with native input focus-visible.

semantics.accessibleName: The required visible label is explicitly associated to the native input with htmlFor/id.
semantics.focus: native input focus with a visible private-shell focus indicator
requirements: The visible label remains explicitly associated with the input by htmlFor/id.
When id is omitted the implementation generates a stable React id for the label/input relationship.
Visible supporting or error messaging is included in aria-describedby while preserving any consumer-provided aria-describedby value.
invalid=true sets aria-invalid=true and uses errorMessage when supplied, otherwise supportingText remains the described message.
Controlled value and uncontrolled defaultValue usage are both supported through native input attributes.
required and disabled remain native input semantics and native attributes are forwarded.
The Text Field always composes the default 44 CSS pixel private input-control shell; no public size prop exists.
Figma content=empty|filled is derived from native value/placeholder behavior rather than a public content prop.

input-control.description: Private governed shell; consumers cannot replace or import it through the public React package.
